statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The procedure was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The diagnosis codes I34.0 and R42 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
